text:
Do you see this corpulent giant
walking with pride and gravity?
Inside he is rags and kindling,
and a porter serves as his foundation.


He lives and moves through that man's soul,
and bends his greatness wherever he wishes;
but whoever examines his rigid appearance
despises his shape and ornament.


Such are the apparent grandeurs
of the tyrants' vain illusion,
fantastic, towering dross.


Do you see them blazing in purple, their hands
in diamonds and assorted stones?
Within they are filth, earth and worms.

translation.title: ¿Miras este gigante corpulento
